subject: Security & Compliance - FinCo discovery follow-up
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Li <emma.li@finco.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 16:12:00 +0000
Subject: Security & Compliance - FinCo discovery follow-up

Hi Emma —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our call + proposed next steps so we're all aligned: 

What we heard from FinCo:
- Primary concerns: SOC 2 status, GDPR data residency for EU customers, potential HIPAA scope for transactions involving PHI.
- Expected timeline: procurement decision target by end of Q3, security questionnaire to be returned within 2 weeks.

Redwood summary / notes:
- Current SOC 2: Type II in progress; controls implementation started March 2026, expected Type II report available by mid-August 2026.
- GDPR: we offer EU region hosted endpoints and customer-managed VPC options for private deployments.
- HIPAA: Redwood can sign BAAs for Dedicated/Private deployments; hosted API requires review of data flows (we discussed tokenization options).

Attachments I mentioned: SOC2_summary.pdf (high level control list + timeline), redacted_vendor_questionnaire.xlsx (template we typically ask customers to fill).

Proposed next steps:
1) I'll share the SOC2_summary.pdf and vendor questionnaire template (attached).
2) FinCo security team to flag any "must have" controls and return questionnaire within 10 business days.
3) We'll schedule a follow-up technical session w/ Rishi (security & infra) and Lauren (product) to go into deployment options — suggested week of June 22.
4) If FinCo needs ISO 27001 or FedRAMP timeline commentary for procurement, we can provide a roadmap summary during the follow-up.

Emma / Alan — are you available for a 45-minute technical session on Tue 23 or Wed 24 (US business hours)?

Thanks —
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0182

Attachments: SOC2_summary.pdf (summary), redacted_vendor_questionnaire.xlsx (template)

From: Emma Li <emma.li@finco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alan Torres <alan.torres@finco.com>, FinCo Security <security@finco.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 09:04:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Security & Compliance - FinCo discovery follow-up

Thanks Marissa — helpful recap.

A few clarifications from our side:
- SOC 2: we need the evidence timeline (when will tests be completed and report issued). Mid-August works as long as controls testing wraps up early August.
- GDPR: can you confirm whether EU region logs are segregated and how long audit logs are retained by default? We may need 12 months retention for some logs.
- HIPAA: not all FinCo traffic is PHI today, but we expect scope expansion later. Can you confirm BAA availability and if any additional controls are required for Hosted API vs Private?

We’ll start the questionnaire internally — aiming to return it within 7–10 business days.

For the technical session, Tue 23 (morning ET) works for Alan and me. Please send an invite.

—Emma
Emma Li
Director, Procurement | FinCo
emma.li@finco.com

Quoted reply: 
> On Mon, 15 Jun 2026 16:12:00 +0000, Marissa Cole wrote:
> > Attachments I mentioned: SOC2_summary.pdf (high level control list + timeline), redacted_vendor_questionnaire.xlsx (template we typically ask customers to fill).

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Li <emma.li@finco.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Alan Torres <alan.torres@finco.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Jun 2026 13:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security & Compliance - FinCo discovery follow-up

Great — thanks Emma. Calendar invite attached (Tue 23 11:00 AM ET) — invite includes agenda: 1) SOC 2 status & evidence timeline, 2) GDPR/data residency and log retention, 3) HIPAA/BAA scoping, 4) vendor questionnaire Qs.

Quick answers to Emma’s bullets: 
- SOC 2: We completed control implementation March–May; independent testing window is scheduled for July 12–20. Final Type II report delivery estimated Aug 12–16. I’ll attach the SOC2_summary.pdf that includes the control status matrix.
- GDPR logs: EU region endpoints keep application logs segregated; default retention is 90 days, but we offer configurable retention policies up to 24 months for Dedicated/Private customers.
- BAA: We can execute a BAA for Dedicated and Private. For Hosted API, we need to review the specific data flow; there are additional controls around tokenization and data deletion obligations.

Attachments: SOC2_summary.pdf (redwood_control_matrix + timeline), redacted_vendor_questionnaire.xlsx (please fill and return).

Next internal asks (Rishi / Lauren):
- Rishi: can you prepare a short one-pager on SOC 2 evidence artifacts we can provide to FinCo (logs, control tests, penetration test summary)? Need by EOD Mon 22.
- Lauren: please draft a 1-paragraph note on deployment options and differences for BAA scope (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private).

Marissa

---
Attachment stubs:
- SOC2_summary.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)
- redacted_vendor_questionnaire.xlsx (Excel, 220KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: FinCo compliance roadmap / asks

Rishi / Lauren —

Looping you both on the thread with FinCo. High priority: they may expand scope to HIPAA and ask about ISO 27001 / FedRAMP readiness in procurement. Two quick items: 

1) Rishi — one-pager on SOC 2 evidence artifacts (logs, change control docs, penetration test summary, vendor attestation) due EOD Mon 22. I’ll attach to the follow-up if ready.

2) Lauren — short blurb on ISO 27001 / FedRAMP roadmap. We’re not certified for ISO yet; current plan is exploratory in H2 2026 with formal scoping in Q4 and potential certification drive in 2027. FedRAMP is longer-term and requires a dedicated effort—we can provide a high-level timeline but not a commitment.

Let me know if you need anything else from Legal or Product Security.

Thanks —
Marissa
